BiblicalUsage: Pitdah is a gem, probably the topaz. It sat in the first row of the high priest's breastplate in Exodus 28:17, and Job 28:19 says the topaz of Ethiopia cannot equal wisdom. Ezekiel 28:13 lists it among the precious stones covering the king of Tyre in Eden.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a stone God set on a priest's heart is worth more than a stone in a king's treasury.
